full_page.content:
Page 79 Cont.
July 1
John Corcoran - 77 - cancerous condicion. Very little hope .....
4 Thanks - Joseph W. Zengerle - 52 - Enrolled in "Ser. Masses" June Ist when in dying condition in Carmel Hosp. "practically dead four hours" ... Is home two weeks. Shaved himself this a.m. They had taken 9 inches of cancerous intestine from him.
Michael Dunkirk - 43 - Drs at witt's end as to what the trouble really is ... One thing he can not be in crowd.
4 th Cath. Courtney - 63 - cancer of bladder - being sent home from Prov. Hosp. - hopeless. Enrolled in Ser. Masses - all urged to "more frequent Communion".
Page 80 July 6 Mrs. Martha Sharp - 67 - hardening of Arteries - almost blind hopes to see her son from Los Angeles away for 15 yrs. married out - Husband good honest man but.
6 Mrs. Blanche Rignot - 65 - ailing for years .... very peculiar cir- cumstances .. for God's guidance and mercy - on her and relatives.
7 Jerry Duggan - 48 - pneumonia - operation in March ... was getting - doing fine - cold last Sat. or Sund. now in oxigen Thom. James Nolan - 78 - operation for malignant .....
8 Thanks - Carolyn Calcagno - 2 - two strokes last July 17 and 19 ... Drs said she'd never walk; walking now, not perfectly but fairly well .....
V. Sister M. Rupert - losing sight - practilly blind in one eye and Drs. say ... "hopeless". Has been teaching 34 years. . . Also Sister Ernest - teaching 35 yrs. - sometimes nerveous.
9 Mrs. M. Holly - Judge H's widow enrolled for cancer ... Came back next day - no trace of the ugly sore on her lip. Aug. 10th En- rolled Poor Souls a hundred times "4th big favor same way.
Page 81 July 13 Mrs. Clara Polzin - 35 - Saginaw - palsey for ten yrs. Some times thinks.
